options: Sends one request straight into the router and returns the response — no network
quiz.explain: oneshot drives the Router as a Service, entirely in memory.

quiz.q: Why split the app into lib.rs and main.rs?
options: So tests in tests/ can import `app()` from the library
quiz.explain: Integration tests can only use a crate's public library items.

quiz.q: In the state test, why `app.clone()` before each request?
options: oneshot consumes the app; clones share the same Arc'd state
quiz.explain: Each clone points at the same shared list, so later requests see earlier changes.
